banned.claim: Gemstone bracelets heal, detox, or balance the body
banned.why: Crystal/gemstone health claims are disease-treatment and unqualified 'detox' claims - banned under health-claim rules.

banned.claim: Boosts immunity or wellness through gemstone energy
banned.why: 'Boosts immunity' is a banned unqualified health claim; jewelry cannot make it.
Products are plated - calling them solid sterling or 14k gold misstates material content; keep the 'plated' qualifier.
'Natural' and 'clean' are vague, risky headline claims not supported by the site.
No such spec appears on the site - do not claim material safety attributes that aren't stated.

banned.claim: Burns fat or relieves anxiety when worn
banned.why: Disease-treatment and 'burns fat' style claims are banned and unsupported for accessories.
